chunks: Turning their backs that they may lead away from the path of God. For such there is disgrace in the world, and on the Day of Judgement We shall make them taste the torment of burning.

key_terms.ثَانِيَ عِطْفِهِ: Turning their backs (idiom for turning away)

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for those who turn away from God's path and mislead others?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Hajj, this verse characterizes the disbelievers who actively turn away from divine guidance to mislead others, a concept Shia exegesis often links to the rejection of the Ahl al-Bayt's authority. It promises them worldly humiliation and the specific torment of 'burning' (al-harīq) in the Hereafter, emphasizing the severity of their deviation from the straight path.
